implementation.inspection: Iterative descriptor snapshot; no ordinary getters/toJSON; cycle and unsupported-value markers; existing cross-document plain-record helper
implementation.rendering: Stable native treeitem/group nodes; visible hierarchy only; iterative painting retains inline short-pair/bracket presentation without recursive rendering
implementation.state: Canonical source/model and expansion atoms; stable encoded JSON Pointer paths; unchanged subtree identity retains expansion
implementation.interaction: One tab entry, arrows/Home/End/Enter/Space, shared Typeahead, RTL, focus recovery, selection-safe pointer disclosure
implementation.highlight: Literal string search or a copied native RegExp; caller lastIndex is not mutated
